steps.code:
# Get all contacts with pagination
all_contacts = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total contacts: {len(all_contacts)}")
# Print names and emails
for c in all_contacts:
    print(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c['email'])
